name: Account Research Agent
businessPurpose: Prepare short account briefs on corporate clients before relationship managers meet them.

logging.destination: Application logs, not yet forwarded to the SIEM

killSwitch.description: Manual: the on-call engineer disables the agent's service account. No tested runbook.

description: Pulls public web and news data plus read-only CRM context about a client and summarizes it into a brief for the relationship manager. It has no write access to any system. The brief is advisory only and a person reads it before using it.
